title: Enterprise onboarding priority gateway for console usage, exports, and dashboards
creator: Amara Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers onboarding to Redwood often submit ad-hoc console/reporting asks (usage exports, tenant-level cost breakdowns, bespoke dashboards) that arrive via Sales, Support, and Solutions Engineering. These requests are high-touch, vary in scope, and frequently block go-live or contract signings. Without a repeatable intake and prioritization gateway, PM/ENG/Design time gets consumed by one-off work with unclear ROI.

Goal: Design a lightweight priority gateway and decision rubric for enterprise onboarding requests related to console/reporting. The gateway should allow Solutions/CS to quickly qualify asks, surface required engineering effort and data prerequisites, and route requests into one of three delivery lanes: Self-serve template + docs, Fast-track sprints (low-effort engineering + templated export), or Enterprise engagement (dedicated project with SLA and POA).

Scope: Focus on non-bug feature asks for: usage analytics exports, per-tenant cost breakdowns, scheduled CSV/Parquet exports, and dashboard templates for billing/consumption. Excludes platform-level infra changes, security audits, and billing system redesigns.

Success metrics: - Reduction in ad-hoc engineering intake time by 40% for onboarding requests within 3 months. - 60% of incoming onboarding reporting asks resolved via self-serve or fast-track lanes. - Time-to-first-delivery median <= 10 business days for fast-track lane.

Stakeholders: - PM: Amara Patel (owner) - Eng: Diego Ramos (assignee) - Design: Linh Nguyen - Solutions Eng: Priya Shah - Sales/CS leads: Marco Chen, Tara O'Neill
acceptance_criteria: A short web form and gating checklist for Solutions/CS to submit requests is available in the internal Console request portal
A scoring rubric (value, effort, compliance risk) is documented and automates a default lane recommendation
Three delivery lanes documented with SLAs and owner roles: Self-serve template, Fast-track (2-week delivery window), Enterprise engagement (POA + kickoff)
Pilot completed with 5 enterprise customers and feedback incorporated into the rubric
Dashboard template library seeded with 3 billing/usage templates and published in the Console template gallery
